description: NOT WIRED YET — declaration only. Servo that would point at the object the camera sees; 0 is left, 180 is right.
note: transport is 'null' on purpose: no servo is physically attached, so commands are recorded and go nowhere. This file exists to demonstrate that adding a device needs no code (VS-4, ADR-0010). When the servo is fitted, change transport to {"type": "serial", "port": "/dev/ttyACM0"}, teach the firmware the SERVO command, and drop the status/note fields.

point.description: Point the servo at a horizontal position

centre.description: Return the servo to the middle
